confidences.reason: Sound. Step 28 explicitly requested a summary focused on pre-2020 publications from Manuela Nagel’s ORCID “Works” section. In Step 29, WebSurfer returned only a high-level biography without any publication-year data or counts, failing the instruction. This omission directly contributed to the final inability to compute the average. It also appears to be the first concrete failure to provide the requested counts after an explicit instruction to do so, and the issue was not corrected later (e.g., Step 42 also lacked counts). Thus, the partner’s identification of WebSurfer at Step 29 satisfies the three criteria.

Unsound. Step 29 is indeed a failure to extract the required pre-2020 works data (the summary is irrelevant), but it is not the first such mistake that relates to the final wrong outcome. Earlier, at Step 10, the Orchestrator explicitly instructed WebSurfer to gather the number of pre-2020 publications. In response, Step 11 (by FileSurfer) merely issued more visit_url calls and provided no counts or extracted data. This failure to follow the instruction to gather and report counts is an earlier mistake directly tied to the final inability to compute the average. The partner’s claim that earlier issues were just inefficiencies that were corrected is contradicted by the repeated non-collection of data from Steps 11, 13, etc., which persisted and were not corrected. Therefore, Step 29 is not the first mistake satisfying the criteria.

Sound. After WebSurfer’s high-level summary at Step 29 failed to extract any publication-year counts, all subsequent actions (Steps 30–37 and Step 42) involved further page visits or generic summaries without deriving numerical pre-2020 counts. The later attempts culminated in explicit admissions of failure to retrieve year-specific data (Steps 39, 44, 47). Although a scraping script was proposed (Step 46), it was not executed to produce counts. Therefore, the missing data was never obtained, and the initial omission remained uncorrected, directly leading to the final inability to compute the average.
Step 29 exists in the log and its agent is 'WebSurfer'.
